verdict.rationale: Codegen documents an official Python SDK. It is a thin pythonic wrapper around the Codegen API with the same capabilities for creating and managing agents, and the docs include a code example (Agent(...).run(prompt=...)). Only a single-language SDK is evidenced, so the plural 'official SDKs' story is only partly covered. missing for 10: official SDKs in languages beyond Python (e.g. TypeScript/JS), a published OpenAPI spec for generating clients (probes returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Programmatically interact with agents using the Python SDK for advanced automation.
The Codegen SDK is a thin pythonic wrapper around the Codegen API with all the same capabilities for creating and managing AI agents programmatically.
